falseSynonyms.zh: mental ability 是透明的廣義改寫；intelligence 更抽象，也常用於理論與測量。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The test measures intelligence. The test measures several forms of mental ability.

falseSynonyms.zh: understanding 只聚焦理解某事，不等於整體智力。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She has high intelligence. She has a deep understanding of physics.

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者很接近；intellect 更正式，偏理性分析與抽象思考。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON His intelligence impressed the team. His intellect was evident in the debate.

falseSynonyms.zh: knowledge 是已掌握的資訊；intelligence 是理解、推理和學習能力。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She has extensive knowledge of history. The task tests reasoning and intelligence.

falseSynonyms.zh: wisdom 強調成熟判斷與經驗，不等於純粹智力。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He is highly intelligent. She showed wisdom in handling the dispute.

falseSynonyms.zh: aptitude 是某一領域的潛質，不是整體智力。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The assessment measures general intelligence. She has an aptitude for languages.

falseSynonyms.zh: cleverness 偏機敏、靈巧或解題聰明，語氣較日常。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The test assesses intelligence. His cleverness helped him find a shortcut.

falseSynonyms.zh: intelligence 是名詞；intelligent 是形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Intelligence can be measured in different ways. She is highly intelligent.
